definitions.full: H7293. Rahab רַ֫הַב noun [masculine] literally storm, arrogance , but only as names, v, infr; — absolute ׳ר Isa 30:7 , רָ֑הַב Job 9:13 +; — 1 mythical sea monster (compare Barton JAOS xiv.1 (1891), 22 f. ): ר ׳עֹזְרֵי Job 9:13 ; || יָם 26:12 ; Psa 89:11 ; || תַּנִּין Isa 51:9 . 2 emblematic name of Egypt , וּבָבֶל רַהַב Psa 87:4 ; || מצרים Isa 30:7 .

occurrences.englishText: He stirs up the sea with his power,
For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
